questions.question: Which player has scored the most double centuries (200+) in this database's history, with two?
questions.explanation: Benade is the only player with two double centuries in this database. Four others (van Niekerk, du Preez, Thomson and Dinesha Devnarain) have one each, six double centuries in total across the database's history.

questions.question: Paulinah Mashishi set a database record (T20) with a value of 67. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Matches Played', held by Paulinah Mashishi.

questions.question: How many fours separate the all-time #1 (Lizelle Lee) and #2 (Mignon du Preez) boundary-hitters (T20) in the 13/14 season?
questions.explanation: Lizelle Lee: 46 — Mignon du Preez: 30 — a gap of 16.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Warriors or Cobras?
At which ground did Jané Winster record their career-best innings (54*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Heat on 2016/02/13.

questions.question: At which ground did Limpopo Lillies record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 144, against Rhinos on 2022/02/05.
